title: Store Manager Bunbury
description:
Our client, a leading international women's fashion retailer, is seeking an experienced Store Manager to lead one of their high-performing stores. With a growing presence across Australia and New Zealand, the brand is known for its fashion-led styling and curated collections across apparel, accessories, swimwear, shapewear, and activewear. This is an opportunity to lead a passionate team focused on customer experience and styling.

Exciting Leadership Opportunity in Women's Fashion!

What's In It For You

  • Competitive base salary of up to $68,000 + Super + Discounts + Incentives
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement
  • Generous staff discounts on fashion-forward products
  • Ongoing training and professional support
  • Tuesday to Saturday roster
  • Recognition and rewards for your outstanding contributions

The Role

As the Manager, you'll be at the forefront of driving sales, exceeding company KPIs, and inspiring a talented sales team. We need a go-getter who thrives working independently and loves styling up a storm. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and motivating your team to achieve and surpass sales goals
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, offering personalised styling advice
  • Implementing visual merchandising standards to create an engaging and inspiring store environment
  • Training and developing your team to ensure exceptional service and performance
  • Being the face of the store, providing a memorable shopping experience for every client

Skills & Requirements

  • 2-3 years of experience in retail management, ideally in apparel
  • A proven ability to deliver personalised styling experiences and a love for styling up a storm
  • Strong communication skills
  • Previous experience in concession management is a plus
  • High energy and a vibrant personality
  • Experience managing budgets and KPIs, and achieving company targets
  • Attention to detail with strong visual merchandising skills

If you're ready to take your retail career to the next level apply now to discover more about this fantastic opportunity!
